title: Tank Arena and Racing as Python training environments
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: Both games can now be trained from Python. One Rust session runs any game, and Python gets three ways in: a PettingZoo environment for several agents, a Gymnasium environment for one, and a bare version that shares memory with Rust. Matches start from the same builds the viewer uses.

A seeded episode from Python gives byte for byte the replay and final hash of the same actions in Rust. Tests check this for both games, and PettingZoo's and Gymnasium's own tests pass. The bridge is its own build, so the engine, the browser build and the runner are unchanged.
next: Soundwave adds the package's CI workflow. Publishing the package is a separate decision.
